messages:
Lena: Heads up — eu-west dedicated rack R-11 saw recurring GPU tail spikes this morning tied to NIC tx-queue blowups. p99 jumped 12x between 05:10-05:30 UTC.
Ravi: Checked telemetry. Not compute-heavy. Lots of tiny inference RPCs from two tenants. NIC tx_skb_drops spike before GPU stalls.
Dmitri: Sounds like queue sandbagging on the onboard NIC. We can't keep penalizing the whole pool with blunt pool-level rate limits.
Nora: Short-term mitigation: per-tenant soft shaping at proxy + node label to avoid new placements on congested nodes. Long-term: pursue SmartNIC offload or eBPF QoS to get true per-tenant isolation.
Lena: PoC proxy config (soft):
```
egress_sandbagging:
  mode: soft
  default_burst_rps: 1500
  tenant_overrides:
    tenant-X1: {burst:1200, sustain:400}
    tenant-Y9: {burst:3000, sustain:1000}
  emit_backpressure: true
```
Ravi: Scheduler change: if node emits backpressure >15s label node "egress_congested" with ttl 10m and refuse co-location for flagged high-concurrency tenants. Also add a placement preference to spread high-conn tenants across NICs/racks.
Dmitri: Billing/legal note: Dedicated customers expect isolation. We should implement opt-in "egress-sandbag" beta with clear SLA exceptions and credit policy. Nora, can product own the comms?
Nora: Yes. I'll draft opt-in beta + pricing credit for affected tenants. Prefer to run canary first.
ops-bot: Runbook created: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/egress-sandbagging. Canary ticket: #INC-6129.
Lena: Canary plan: single hot-rack tonight 22:00 UTC. Monitor nic_tx_drops, nic_queue_len_p95, gpu_p99_by_node, tenant_conn_rps, backpressure_events for 45m.
Ravi: Metrics to add: tenant_egress_sandbag_active, node_backpressure_seconds, per_tenant_conn_p95. Also short retention of packet-level traces for canary window.
Dmitri: If canary succeeds, rollout gradual per-region and follow with SmartNIC/eBPF spike to evaluate cost vs benefit. SmartNIC helps avoid proxy CPU pressure.
Nora: I'll prepare customer note and beta form once canary passes.
Lena: Thanks team — will kick off canary and post results here.
